research.searchCoverage: Parma is a relationship-centric CRM operated from Sunnyvale, California. Pinned source and Pipedream document GET https://app.parma.ai/api/v1/users/me with Authorization Bearer. Workspace API tokens are created at https://app.parma.ai/api (OAuth also exists on Pipedream; native uses the documented API token). GET /api/v1/pipelines, /api/v1/users, and /api/v1/deals are pinned read routes. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Parma CRM compromise (Pares AI is unrelated). Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /api/v1/users/me, matching the pinned credential validator and Pipedream example.
Authorization uses Bearer {{apiKey}}. GET omits Content-Type and the upstream user-agent. Native category is crm.
Returns raw Parma JSON under data rather than unwrapping data.user.
Calls documented GET /api/v1/users/me. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
Calls GET /api/v1/pipelines with no query. Returns raw Parma JSON under data. Writes omitted.
Calls GET /api/v1/users with optional opaque page query matching Composio PARMA_LIST_USERS. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
Calls GET /api/v1/deals with optional opaque page query matching the pinned source. Pagination is caller controlled and provider next links are never followed.
Calls GET /api/v1/groups with optional query and page. Pinned source documents query; page matches Composio PARMA_LIST_GROUPS.
Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
POST /api/v1/notes with body, relationship_ids, and optional datetime. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
GET /api/v1/notes with optional page. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
PATCH /api/v1/notes/{id} with optional body, datetime, and relationship_ids. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
GET /api/v1/pipelines/{id}. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
POST /api/v1/relationships with name, required group_ids, and optional type, company_id, about. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
DELETE /api/v1/relationships/{id}. Parma returns HTTP 204 with an empty body; AppCall wraps that as data: null. request.result is omitted so the raw JSON contract stays truthful.
GET /api/v1/relationships/{id}. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
POST /api/v1/relationships/{relationship_id}/groups with group_id. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
GET /api/v1/relationships/{relationship_id}/groups. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
DELETE /api/v1/relationships/{relationship_id}/groups/{relationship_group_id}. HTTP 204 empty body is wrapped as data: null.
GET /api/v1/relationships with optional name, type, page, and contact-detail filters matching the pinned source. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
GET /api/v1/relationships/{relationship_id}/notes with optional page. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
PATCH /api/v1/relationships/{id} with optional name, type, company_id, group_ids, about, and properties. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
GET /api/v1/stages/{id}. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
GET /api/v1/stages. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.
GET /api/v1/users/{id}. Returns raw Parma JSON under data.

Composio PARMA_PACKAGE_LIST is Comune di Parma CKAN, not Parma CRM. GET https://dati.comune.parma.it/api/3/action/package_list. Connector Bearer header is still sent; the public CKAN endpoint ignores it.
Composio PARMA_DATA_JSON is the DCAT-US data.json from Comune di Parma's open-data portal.
